items.content_html: MiniChat is a lightweight WhatsApp-style messaging web app built using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and EJS. items.content_html: A lightweight utility for Node.js projects that accumulates items into fixed-size batches per key, preserving insertion order within each key. Streams items directly into their respective batches at runtime, eliminating the overhead of post-processing 1D arrays into chunks. It abstracts key-based batch management.
